name: TOMAZE
notes: A free, open-source maze game made with Clickteam Fusion 2.5 (myonegameisopensourced.itch.io/tomaze): a 32-bit exe that unpacks Fusion's runtime into %TEMP% and draws through mmf2d3d9.dll, the Direct3D 9 renderer Ultimate Custom Night uses. Its profile is the default one (dxmt tree: Wine's builtin d3d9 on wined3d's OpenGL renderer), the path a Fusion game without a profile takes.
